title: Article 150 — Form of accounts of the Union and of the States

content.overview: Article 150 provides that the accounts of the Union and of the States shall be kept in such form as the President may, on the advice of the Comptroller and Auditor-General of India, prescribe.
content.glance: Form of Union and State accounts: prescribed by the President on the advice of the CAG.
content.study:
Article 150 links the form of public accounts to Presidential prescription on the advice of the CAG, ensuring professional audit input into the structure of accounts.

Examination: President prescribes form; on advice of CAG; Union and States.

sections.heading: Key rule
sections.body: Accounts of the Union and of the States shall be kept in such form as the President may, on the advice of the CAG, prescribe.

questionsAndAnswers.question: Who prescribes the form of accounts under Article 150?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: Under Article 150, the accounts of the Union and of the States shall be kept in such form as the President may, on the advice of the Comptroller and Auditor-General of India, prescribe.

examTips: President on CAG’s advice prescribes form of accounts.

keyTakeaways: Art 150: form of Union and State accounts — President on CAG’s advice.
